titolo: Jensen Huang Is Back: The Call That Flipped Nvidia's Board
angolo: Six days after the board said no, one weekend of White House pressure flipped the decision, added nearly $1 trillion in value, and set up a Senate hearing on Dec 3.
descrizione: Jensen Huang Is Back: The Call That Flipped Nvidia's Board. Nvidia's board reinstated Huang as CEO on Nov 23, 2026, six days after saying it did not intend to. President Trump says he spoke to the board directly; Nvidia says it received input from senior levels of the US government. Shares jumped about 31% and lifted tech stocks, Europe and bitcoin. The Senate Banking Committee says Huang will testify on December 3.

scene.testo: Nvidia's stock just jumped thirty-one percent in a single day.
Nearly one trillion dollars in market value was added in a single session, by several estimates.
The reason: a CEO the board had said it would not take back.
Six days earlier, the chairman said on the earnings call that the board did not intend to reinstate him.
Then President Trump publicly urged the board to bring him back.
What changed the board's position in one weekend?
Stay with me. The answer involves a phone call, and the board's own statement.
First, who is the man at the center of this?
Jensen Huang was born in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1963.
At nine, his parents sent him to live in the United States.
In 1993, he co-founded Nvidia.
He ran it for thirty-three years.
He built it into a company worth about four trillion dollars powering the AI boom.
Then, on November twelfth, he resigned.
It followed reports of affairs, one with a woman US officials suspect is a Chinese spy, according to Yahoo Finance.
Huang admitted to extramarital affairs, according to reports.
Chief financial officer Colette Kress became interim CEO.
Harvey Jones was named Nvidia's first-ever board chair.
Markets did not like it. Nvidia fell roughly twenty-eight percent over the seven trading days after his resignation, according to Motley Fool data.
Reuters reports last week's global market rout was triggered in part by the crisis.
The S&P 500 and Dow ended last Friday in correction territory.
But a campaign to bring him back was already growing.
More than two hundred thousand people had signed an open letter for his return by Monday, according to its website.
Signers listed included Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, according to Fortune and Euronews.
On November seventeenth, Huang said publicly he would be honored to return if the board asked.
The board answered the same day, on the earnings call.
Chair Harvey Jones was blunt.

citazione.testo: The Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO.

scene.testo: The board also created a national security oversight committee.
Case closed? Not even close. In a moment, how it reopened.
Sunday night, November twenty-second.
President Trump posts on Truth Social.

citazione.testo: I hope the Board of Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang. It would be the best thing for the Company, and also, for the U.S.A.

scene.testo: He told CNBC he also spoke to Huang on Sunday night.
Trump says his administration assured Nvidia there were no national security concerns.
Vice President JD Vance was also involved, according to a person familiar with the matter cited by the Hollywood Reporter, and Semafor.
Trump told CNBC he spoke to the board directly and indirectly.
Semafor reported, citing people familiar, that he dialed into the board meeting. Trump declined to say.
On Monday, Trump told CNBC the board had done what he wanted.

citazione.testo: The board decided to do what we wanted them to do.

scene.testo: Monday morning, Nvidia made it official.
The vote was unanimous. Effective immediately.
Eleven days after he resigned.
The board said it received input from senior levels of the US government.
Based on that, it is confident his return poses no national security risk.
That was the key line.
Chair Harvey Jones framed it as a matter of leadership.

citazione.testo: The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers.

scene.testo: The board also said it was satisfied with Huang's candor and ability to lead.
Colette Kress goes back to her previous responsibilities as CFO.
Huang said he returns with humility and renewed commitment.

citazione.testo: I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment.

scene.testo: Trump wrote that the board had made the correct and proper decision.
And the market reacted at once.
Nvidia opened up around thirty percent.
It closed up about thirty-one and a half percent, at $165.05.
Yahoo Finance says it was the stock's third-best day on record.
Several outlets report it was the biggest one-day gain in market value by any company on record.
Huang's own fortune rose by about thirty-four billion dollars, Forbes says.
The Nasdaq Composite jumped about six and a half percent.
The Dow gained about fourteen hundred points, CNBC reports.
It was Wall Street's best day since April 2025, CNBC reports.

visivo.testo: It was Wall Street's best day since April 2025, CNBC reports.

scene.testo: The S&P 500 added about four point seven percent, CNBC reports.
CNBC reports chip stocks led the rally.
Several analysts also upgraded the stock, according to a market explainer.
Analyst Dan Ives said in a note that the board knew it had no choice but to bring him back.
Yet shares still closed below their pre-resignation level, according to Motley Fool.
Elon Musk cheered Huang's return, saying 'fair-weather friends are worthless.'
But not everyone is celebrating. The harder test is still ahead.
The Senate Banking Committee said Huang will testify at a public hearing on December third.
Senator Elizabeth Warren, the committee's ranking Democrat, called the reinstatement reckless.
She said Huang, Nvidia executives and the board still owe Congress answers about export-control compliance.
Senator Ruben Gallego said Congress should investigate the administration's role and stock positions before the announcement.
Chuck Schumer said the reinstatement showed it was critical to pass legislation toughening chip export restrictions on China.
Trump says Huang did nothing wrong.
Nvidia says the investigation by its independent committee will proceed to conclusion.
Nvidia's board says Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
Investors told Axios they are concerned about how much time he will spend before Congress.
Bloomberg reports the move raises questions about the board's independence.
Eleven days from resignation to return. A reversal one analyst called one of the most extraordinary in Wall Street history.
Huang said he is honored to return and lead Nvidia at the beginning of a new industrial revolution.

citazione.testo: I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution.

scene.testo: The December third hearing is next. The story is still moving, so subscribe.
